We unite eight of the country's most respected independent vacation rental companies under one platform, combining deep local expertise with enterprise-grade capital, technology, and back-office infrastructure.</p><p>Our founding brands collectively manage approximately 3,000 homes across 10+ destinations in Florida, the Carolinas, Texas, Colorado, and Tennessee, with an average guest rating of 4.8 stars.</p><p>Each brand maintains the local identity its guests know and love, while Stayd Collective provides shared services across HR and payroll, marketing, technology, finance, and accounting.</p><p>We also own our own data. StaydOS, our proprietary operating system, brings information from across our software stack into one centralized system, providing real-time portfolio visibility and giving our accounting team a single source of truth.</p><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p><p>As an Accounts Payable Accountant, you will own the payables cycle from invoice intake through payment and reconciliation.</p><p>Every cleaning, pool service, repair, utility, and other vendor bill across our portfolio flows through this role. Accurate invoice coding is critical to ensuring our owner statements and P&amp;Ls are correct the first time.</p><p>You'll work daily in Guesty and QuickBooks Online alongside the Accounting Manager, maintaining accurate vendor records and ensuring all financial activity is properly documented, reconciled, and audit-ready.</p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li>Process daily vendor Accounts Payable transactions through Guesty.</li><li>Post reimbursable operating expenses in QuickBooks Online.</li><li>Accurately code invoices to the correct property, entity, and expense account, including cleaning, maintenance, utilities, HOA and resort fees, supplies, and other operating expenses.</li><li>Distinguish owner-billable expenses from company costs to ensure accurate owner chargebacks at the source.</li><li>Manage the A/P inbox and ensure invoices move efficiently through review and approval.</li><li>Prepare and process payment runs.</li><li>Complete monthly vendor reconciliations and work directly with vendors to resolve discrepancies.</li><li>Onboard new vendors and collect and maintain required W-9 documentation.</li><li>Prepare annual 1099 filings.</li><li>Reconcile company credit card and expense activity, following up on missing receipts and incorrect or incomplete coding.</li><li>Prepare draft bank reconciliations.</li><li>Prepare A/P accruals and support the month-end close process.</li><li>Support annual audits and financial reporting.</li><li>Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date financial and vendor records.</li></ul><p><strong>Requirements</strong></p><p><strong>Must-Have Qualifications</strong></p><ul><li>Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.</li><li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.</li><li>3+ years of accounting experience, with 5+ years preferred, working with a U.S., Canadian, Australian, or UK-based employer.</li><li>2+ years of property management or vacation rental accounting experience.</li><li>Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online.</li><li>Demonstrated experience handling high-volume Accounts Payable.</li><li>Strong attention to detail and accuracy when coding and processing invoices.</li><li>Ability to work some hours aligned with the Eastern Time Zone (U.S. Eastern time (ET)) and occasional weekends.</li><li>Full-time availability of 40–45 hours per week.</li></ul><p><strong>Nice-to-Have Qualifications</strong></p><ul><li>Experience working with Guesty PMS.</li><li>Familiarity with Topkey.</li><li>Familiarity with NetSuite.</li><li>Experience preparing 1099 filings.</li><li>Familiarity with Notion and Slack.</li><li>Experience working with an A/P automation or expense management platform.</li><li>Experience with property-level or trust accounting.</li></ul><p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p><p>We're looking for someone who is:</p><ul><li>Extremely detail-oriented and committed to accuracy.</li><li>Trustworthy when handling sensitive financial and vendor information.</li><li>Process-driven, organized, and reliable.</li><li>Able to manage a high volume of invoices while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.</li><li>Professional, responsive, and courteous when communicating with vendors.</li><li>A strong problem-solver who can identify and resolve discrepancies rather than allowing issues to accumulate.</li><li>A fast learner with strong technical aptitude and the ability to adapt to new systems.</li><li>Comfortable working in a growing, fast-paced environment.</li><li>Accountable for their work and able to follow processes consistently.</li></ul><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p><p>$18,000–$26,000 USD annually, based on experience and qualifications.</p><p>By applying, you agree that Stayd may contact you about your application by email and WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to opt out.</p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a
